messages:
emma: heads-up: deploy-bot put RC promotion on HOLD. artifact consistency check failed for rc/backend-1.2.0.tar.gz. deploy-bot: "verify mismatch: expected sha256=aa11ff...ee got sha256=bb22cc...99". Anyone seeing replicator alerts?

frank: looking at artifact-publisher logs. seeing repeated "part reassembly timeout" errors from mirror-2 during multipart copy. origin still matches expected sha.

deploy-bot: PROMOTE_HOLD: reason=artifact-hash-mismatch, candidate=bb22cc...99, last_verified=aa11ff...ee, triggered_by=integration-smoke.

gina: can we re-sync mirror and resume? reupload would change object timestamp which breaks immutability policy. prefer pin-to-last-verified then investigate.

harry: agreed pinning is safest for the release window. if we reupload we need provenance note. also suggest adding a guard in publish pipeline: fail promotion if any mirror returns different checksum within 10m.

emma: +1 pin. minimal customer impact and keeps release on schedule. @deploy-bot please accept manual approval from me to promote aa11ff...ee to rc.

deploy-bot: ACK. awaiting manual_approve from emma. command: `/deploybot approve promote rc --sha=aa11ff...ee --reason "pin last_verified to avoid mirror divergence"`

emma: /deploybot approve promote rc --sha=aa11ff...ee --reason "pin last_verified to avoid mirror divergence"

ci-bot: queued: artifact-verify (no rebuild) and canary-smoke rerun. logs: artifact-verify shows mirror-2 served different bytes for range 1048576-2097151.

frank: confirmed mirror-2 had transient IO stall -> returned stale multipart chunk. origin s3 shows correct sha=aa11ff...ee. filing INF-2400: mirror multipart race + missing post-replication-verify.

gina: adding quick mitigation: hold auto-promotes if artifact-verify reports byte-range mismatch across any replica. will open PR to artifact-publish.

harry: release note blurb: "RC promotion pinned to previously verified artifact due to mirror replication inconsistency; no change to binary contents on origin; investigating mirror multipart replication."

emma: action items: (1) manual promote complete (frank) (2) INF-2400 assigned to frank/gina (3) add pipeline guard and post-replication checksum (gina) (4) doc blurb for release notes (harry).

frank: manual promote executed, canary-smoke green. deploy-bot: PROMOTE_COMPLETE: rc -> sha256:aa11ff...ee. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: PROMOTE_COMPLETE: rc -> aa11ff...ee.

emma: thanks all. follow-up: run mirror-consistency scan for last 48h and schedule short maintenance if other divergences present.

gina: will add regression to CI that fails publish if any mirror chunk mismatch is detected.

harry: I'll draft the release note and include INF-2400 link. closing thread after ticket is created.
